title: code.orchestrate-review output
description: The step's output is the plain string the controller passes as `next.output` on its `resolve` move — `submit_step_progress` types `output` as a string, so there is no object here. By convention it carries the verdict and the PR URL: "REQUEST_CHANGES on https://github.com/o/r/pull/7: 2 of 5 comments unaddressed."
